title: tier-2 shipped code: the type-3 mesh narrowphase against 0x142caed30

unreachableBranches.why: The support-point path (count > 0) builds the rotation and folds the block against the centre and half extent, then hands every triangle to 0x142cc9460, which is unread. Every fixture case passes count = 0.

The leaf dispatch reaches the leaf block only when the node's triangle count is non-zero (0x142caf3b8), and r12d is loaded from that same byte at 0x142caf425, so the repeated zero test always falls through.
The callback register r13 is always null: the wrapper 0x142caed10 passes cb = 0, and the probe has no callback argument. The null test always jumps to 0x142caf5c5.
The stack buffer is only never handed back by free when the walk exceeds its 64-node inline stack and reallocates (0x142cadee0). No fixture walks deeper than three nodes, so the free path is dead.

notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/collide.rs (mesh_sweep), called by crates/ow-sim/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the mesh_sweep entry.

The oracle runs the real 0x142caed30 and the harness compares the whole 0x44-byte output pointee byte for byte: the three quads, the triangle index at +0x30, the two record ids at +0x34/+0x36, the 0xffff mark at +0x38 and both walk counters at +0x3c/+0x40.
The registered entry is the wrapper at 0x142caed10 (shape entry -> pool element at +0x48); this unit verifies the body it forwards to, so the wrapper's rewrite is not covered.
The unit declares the body's extent (0x977) because the image's .pdata entry describes the wrapper.

The declared specials pin the diagonal split of the quad (which triangle index wins), the miss beside the mesh, the back face, a sweep that starts past the plane, a zero-length query, the block layer mask, the triangle layer mask, a degenerate triangle, two stacked faces (last accepted wins over nearest) and a rotated transform.
acknowledgedGaps: Only the count <= 0, fast-path mesh is verified. The support-point path (0x142cc9460), the triangle test's slow-enter path (expansion > 0.005), a BVH axis >= 2 (whose direction slot is never written), the depth-64 stack realloc at 0x142cadee0, the BVH builder and the geometry ingest remain open.

acknowledgedGaps.why: The body's declared extent spans two regions this unit cannot run. The count > 0 support-point path (0x142caef15-0x142caf1a5) holds five branch sites and is unread, so it never executes; the callback block after the null test at 0x142caf5ac holds two more and needs a non-null cb, which the type-3 wrapper never supplies. Seven of the 22 discovered sites are therefore permanently uncovered, and the tracker rejects declaring a site that never ran. The reachable ceiling for a fast-path-only unit is 11 of the 18 countable sites (61%). The measured value is recorded and the gate is 55; the 328-case differential and the mutation stage carry this unit.

knownEquivalentMutants.rationale: `count as usize * MESH_VERTEX_LEN` sits inside `if count > 0`, and no fixture case can make `count` non-zero: the support-point branch hands every triangle to `0x142cc9460`, which is unread, so the unit declares that edge unreachable at `0x7ff7c79cef0f` and every case passes `count = 0`. The slice is therefore never taken and `*` and `/` are both unexecuted - equivalent for this corpus, not in general. If the support path is ever read and a case can reach it, delete this declaration.
